task_81_path_payload.diagnosis: The payload mostly referenced local markdown paths such as data/targets/cangjie/reverse-prd.md. test_agent fetches URLs in config fields, but does not expand local relative file paths, so the analyzer received too little actionable business/API context.

optimization.change: Inline PRD, API contract, test data, rules, focus areas, and known calibration risks directly into the task config. Add a locator fallback from missing label[for="field-id"] selectors to [id="field-id"] controls.

task_82_inline_payload.stop_reason: Stopped manually after confirming the optimized input passed analysis/design and after execution made no progress beyond the first timed-out case.

first_result.backend_error_observed: Playwright timed out waiting for label[for="username-input"] and label[for="password-input"].

platform_findings: Inline task inputs fix the no-exploration-goals failure mode for this target.
Generated cases included useful credential-calibration coverage, including the one-click-fill password mismatch.
Execution needs stronger per-case preconditions/state reset. Login-page cases should clear session or navigate to a known logged-out state before looking for username/password fields.
Execution progress should surface per-case timeout and active locator/action in task checkpoints so long-running runs are easier to diagnose.
The runtime locator fallback has been patched in code, but the running 8002 backend was not restarted because unrelated tasks 74 and 75 were still running.
